So, I've done some testing. 

It's actually the `updateSelectizeInput` with `server =  TRUE` that it's failing. If I specify some dummy choices in `selectizeinput` in the ui.R or updateSelectizeInput with `server =  FALSE`  it works fine. However it doesn't work if I specify the choices in the updateSelectizeInput with `server =  TRUE` on sever.R. 

Locally I was using using shiny version 0.11.1.9004. I've just updated to the latest version 0.12 and I've noticed that the `server = TRUE` is not working as in the previous shiny versions, as now all the choices appear at once.

Do you think it could be an issue of which version of shiny is running on the shinyapps.io server?

Anyway, I've re-deployed my application using  `server =  FALSE` and I will keep it like that until i find a fix.


m.

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Selectize input not working
parts:
Sorry about that. I think this is due to a recent change I made in
shiny: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/pull/823 but I cannot imagine
how the error you mentioned could occur (the error should be from
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/blob/808d7aab3f6/R/update-input.R#L453
I think NULL was passed to fromJSON() then introduced the error).

The selectize input (server = TRUE) in shiny 0.12 does not really load
all the options at once: it loads the first n options specified in the
option maxOptions initially. The default value of maxOptions is 1000.
You can reduce this number via the `options` argument, e.g.

library(shiny)
shinyApp(
ui = fluidPage(
selectizeInput('foo', 'Foo', choices = NULL, options = list(maxOptions = 5))
),
server = function(input, output, session) {
updateSelectizeInput(session, 'foo', choices = letters, server = TRUE)
}
)

If you can provide a minimal example to reproduce your problem, I can
certainly fix it. Thanks a lot!

Regards,
Yihui
--
